en: Black‑and‑white / sepia postcard view of a quiet street lined with early 20th‑century residential and commercial buildings. The foreground shows a large, multi‑storey house with a steep tiled roof, dormer windows, and a fenced front yard. Similar houses and small apartment blocks extend into the distance along a wide, mostly empty street with telegraph poles. At the top, printed in red, is the caption identifying the location as Flöha and the specific street as Carolastrasse.
